description: Shadcn/Radix Button (src/components/ui/button.tsx). Renders a native <button> (or a Radix Slot child when asChild). Variants: default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link. Sizes: default, sm, lg, icon. Focus-visible ring for keyboard users; disabled blocks pointer events and halves opacity.

tailwindClasses.container: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors
tailwindClasses.interactive: focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring hover:bg-primary/90 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed

notes: loading and error are NOT native states of this component: loading is composed (disabled + spinner child); error is represented by the destructive variant.

Per-variant hover tokens: destructive hover:bg-destructive/90, outline hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground, secondary hover:bg-secondary/80, ghost hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground, link hover:underline.
active state uses the default pressed look from browser/tailwind base; no custom active: token is defined.
asChild forwards ref/className to the Radix Slot (for links, e.g. <Button asChild><Link/></Button>).
